citation.reference: IC 15-16-5-59 (355 IAC 4-4 voided by P.L.29-2024); OISC recordkeeping guidance (supporting)

appliesTo: Commercial and private applicators; restricted-use pesticide applications (IC 15-16-5-59). Label-directed records (e.g., dicamba) are separate.
notes: 355 IAC 4-4 (commercial applicator use records) was voided by P.L. 29-2024 effective July 1, 2024. OISC’s March 12, 2024 guidance is the current agency list for restricted-use pesticide application records (2-year retention; no required form). Do not treat the voided IAC field list as still in force. Customer-copy-on-request language was in the voided rule; this matrix does not invent a replacement day count. 2026-09-24 primary-text audit: R6 scope quote: “Sec. 59. (a) As required in 40 CFR 171, commercial applicators and private applicators shall maintain records concerning the application of restricted use pesticides.” General-use private sprays keep the core boxes. Amount may be packaged product or diluted mixture + AI %. Keep 2 years; no clock. The old general-use record duty (355 IAC 4-4) was voided effective July 1, 2024.
